description: Fixed cross-engine comparison cases; expectations are independent of either implementation.

cases.scenario: Mixed 200/205/210/215 lb sets with 3/3/2/2 reps against 5–8
cases.expected: No all-set promotion to unearned 215 lb; safe next step grounded in observed capacity

cases.scenario: 215 lb for all sets at 2 reps near failure
cases.expected: No increase and no accidental repetition of failing loads

cases.scenario: Repeated completed upper-rep-range work with actual RIR
cases.expected: Earned, physical-stock-valid increment; never inferred from targets

cases.scenario: 4 sets with progressively declining reps and high fatigue
cases.expected: Differentiate early-set capacity from repeatable all-set capacity

cases.scenario: At one verified working weight, sets complete 14/13/12 reps in 10–15 with actual RIR 3/3/2; also test all-set RIR 2, missing RIR and near failure
cases.expected: If effort permits, at most one extra rep on one demonstrably capable set for review; no +2/+3 jumps, no wholesale all-set increases and no issued-target overwrite

cases.scenario: RIR missing despite an issued RIR target
cases.expected: Do not treat prescribed RIR as measured effort

cases.scenario: Machine requires 5-lb increments; candidate load 159.5 or 38.5
cases.expected: No unbuildable or unverified weights

cases.scenario: Known bar weight and actual plate pairs
cases.expected: Only suggest exactly buildable external load

cases.scenario: Exercise, attachment or Smith absent from selected gym
cases.expected: No gym-incompatible prescriptions or cycle previews

cases.scenario: Custom workout with pinned exercises and myo/drop techniques advances block
cases.expected: Retain author intent and correct warmups, techniques and RIR

cases.scenario: Create, clone, edit, save and resume a completely custom program
cases.expected: Full first-class authoring beyond legacy web workflow

cases.scenario: Hypertrophy block ~30 sets transitions to strength block ~11
cases.expected: No unjustified volume collapse; use explicit phase policy and dose bounds

cases.scenario: Within one training block, an override changes 5-to-3 or 3-to-5 total/direct working sets, with both weeks separately inside MEV/MRV
cases.expected: No unreviewed weekly set loss or sharp weekly dose ramp; apply explicit athlete-specific percentage limits to total and individual direct-muscle work without overwriting authored slots or misclassifying recovery weeks

cases.scenario: Bench-priority strength block in four or five days
cases.expected: Adapt frequency when approved, with recovery feasibility

cases.scenario: 3–6 day FB/UL/PPL/ULPPL with gym and locked days
cases.expected: Consistent feasible weekly plan, dose and rests

cases.scenario: 40–60, 60–90, 120+ preference and shorter-session request
cases.expected: Realistic elapsed time, preserve safe priorities and approved caps

cases.scenario: Direct biceps vs brachialis and wrist flexion vs extension
cases.expected: Count separate muscular dose channels without double counting

cases.scenario: Low readiness and injured-muscle restrictions during active workout
cases.expected: No contraindicated prescribed work, explicit adaptive substitution

cases.scenario: Finish repeated after lost acknowledgment and process death
cases.expected: Exactly one durable completion, no duplicate records

cases.scenario: Edit older set after more recent workout; inspect PR/Last
cases.expected: Preserve chronology, corrections and recent observations

cases.scenario: 4,097+ workouts and correction of a historical workout
cases.expected: No 4,096-record ceiling and no lost or fabricated entries

cases.scenario: Real legacy export with custom IDs, history, bodyweight and preferences
cases.expected: Inspect, reconcile, approve, restore and rollback without lost facts

cases.scenario: Crash/power loss during import and redo before acknowledgment
cases.expected: Crash-safe restore, no dual authority or silent data reset

cases.scenario: Offline onboarding to plan, logged workout, Finish, corrected history and next plan
cases.expected: Entire Kotlin-authoritative Compose journey works on Android

cases.scenario: 20 original themes, large font, TalkBack, Focus and foldable screens
cases.expected: Accessible polished native experience without feature loss

cases.scenario: Independent coach sees blinded generated program and cycle outputs
cases.expected: At least as good as web across dose, fatigue, safety and programming
